blocks.text: The people in Albion’s dugout. A sourced profile in our growing managers collection.

parts.text: Mowbray led Albion to the 2007/08 Championship title. His first spell began with a 3–0 home win over Wolves in October 2006 and ended with a goalless draw at Blackburn in May 2009.

Albion: appointment and Brunt handover, 17 January 2025

parts.text: Albion announced his return on 17 January 2025, but Chris Brunt still took the Stoke match the following day. Mowbray’s first match back was at Middlesbrough on 21 January.

sources.label: Albion: appointment and Brunt handover, 17 January 2025

parts.text: His second spell ended on 21 April 2025 after the home defeat by Derby. James Morrison took interim charge.

parts.text: First-spell totals are unresolved: this saved archive contains 139 matches (56 wins, 33 draws, 50 defeats; goals 223–191), while Albion’s 17 January 2025 retrospective reports 140 (58 wins, 30 draws, 52 defeats; 232 goals scored). Use recorded-match totals with this warning, not an unqualified career total.

A missing Peterborough FA Cup replay on 13 January 2009 and the Hartlepool extra-time score on 26 August 2008 have been identified for a separate source-backed archive correction. The retrospective’s remaining differences are not yet reconciled.

This is one of three researched profiles in a growing collection, not a complete history of Albion’s managers. Competitive results, wartime and recovery football, and annulled fixtures have separate ledgers. Recorded-match totals do not automatically establish a manager’s full career record.
